name.en: Romance scam: an online partner who needs money

how.en: Someone you meet online builds a close relationship over weeks or months but never meets you. They have a story, such as a surgeon stuck abroad or an engineer working overseas, and start asking for money, one transfer after another. Some victims in Malta sent hundreds of thousands of euros.

text.en: A stranger online becomes very affectionate quickly.
They can never meet or video call.
They ask you to keep it between you.
They ask for money for an emergency, travel or fees, again and again.

My love, the hospital here still won’t release my salary until I pay the clearance fee. I hate asking you again, you are the only one I trust. Please don’t tell your sister, she won’t understand us. €1,400 and I can finally fly to you.

en: met him online and never in person
sent money to someone I met online
he says he loves me and needs money
Someone you have never met asking for money.
Excuses for never meeting or video calling.
Being asked to keep the relationship secret.
Stop sending money, whatever the reason.
Talk to someone you trust and report it to the Police.
For support, call the Victim Support Agency on 116 006.

sources.title: Police investigated €13 million worth of scams in first 6 months this year
